purpose: Candidate public option-chain, reference, statistics and delayed-quote sources for the shared LINE Bot. Catalog membership never authorizes runtime use.

providers.name: Cboe U.S. Options public market data and statistics
providers.review_notes: The official delayed-quote page expressly prohibits auto-extraction programs, queries and software. Manual display availability does not authorize bot ingestion or redistribution.

providers.name: OCC public market data reports
providers.review_notes: OCC publishes batch-processing examples, but its governing Terms of Use prohibit launching automated systems to access the Services. The stricter governing term controls this project decision.

providers.name: Market Data Free Forever options API
providers.authority: Market Data SRL and its licensed market-data suppliers
providers.review_notes: The Free Forever plan offers capped 24-hour-delayed options data for personal/internal use, but the official redistribution policy prohibits making recent data available to other users. A shared LINE Bot therefore cannot use this self-service plan without a separate commercial and exchange redistribution license, which would violate the free-only requirement.

providers.name: Tradier brokerage market-data API
providers.review_notes: Tradier exposes options market data together with brokerage onboarding, account funding, trading and account-management capabilities. The shared LINE architecture permanently forbids broker-account entitlements, broker tokens and any LINE-to-broker bridge, so this source is ineligible even if an individual account could obtain data access.

providers.name: Nasdaq public option-chain pages
providers.review_notes: Automated API access, free-tier continuity and redistribution rights remain unverified; website display alone is not sufficient.

providers.name: NYSE Options official product and market reference
providers.review_notes: Product and rules pages are authoritative, but a free automated BID/ASK interface and redistribution grant remain unverified.

providers.name: CME Group delayed futures and options quotes
providers.review_notes: Futures-options scope does not satisfy U.S. equity-option requirements; automated and redistribution rights remain pending.

providers.name: Eurex official derivatives product and public market information
providers.review_notes: Official market information is catalogued only; free automated quote access and republication rights remain pending.

providers.name: HKEX official derivatives market data
providers.review_notes: Regional official source retained for diversity; automated quote access and redistribution rights remain pending.

providers.name: TAIFEX official options market data
providers.review_notes: Authoritative Taiwan source retained for later regional support; automated and republication rights remain pending.

providers.name: JPX Osaka Exchange official derivatives information
providers.review_notes: Official derivatives information retained for diversity; automated access and redistribution rights remain pending.

providers.name: ASX official equity options information
providers.review_notes: Official equity-options information retained for diversity; automated access and redistribution rights remain pending.
